messages:
incident-bot: PAGED: blueharbor-prod (vpc-42) - elevated 5xx rate on model endpoint /v1/generate. Severity: SEV-2. On-call: @oncall-eng-sre. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/vpc-fallback

lucy: I'm on it — joining Zoom 10.0.0.5:9012. Starting quick blast assessment.

omar: saw the alert, tailing logs now. initial spike started ~4765432050.

emily-cs: BlueHarbor CS says customer is seeing ~35% request failures in their payments flow. They're starting to degrade UX.

raj: quick snapshot: 5xxs are concentrated on requests with seq_len>1024 and model variant "prod-large-v2" -> OOM-ish errors on a subset of VMs in dedicated pool D-9.

lucy: plan propose: 1) pin blueharbor tenant to safe-variant small-quant (safe-small-v1) 2) route traffic away from impacted D-9 nodes to D-7 3) enable short circuit fallback to cached prefix for high-latency reqs.

kevin-sre: +1. Need API calls to pin and reroute. I'll run them with you, @lucy.

omar: logs: 
```
ERROR gpu_mem_exhausted at infer.cpp:1420
trace: kv_cache alloc fail for keysize 12MB
context: model=prod-large-v2 shard=3 pool=D-9
```

lucy: executing pin now. curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/tenants/blueharbor/pin 
-H "Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"safe-small-v1","reason":"emergency pin: OOM in prod-large-v2"}'

incident-bot: ACTION LOGGED: pin requested by lucy at 4765432078. Audit id: audit-9b2c.

emily-cs: I've notified BlueHarbor support lead; they asked for ETA and mitigation steps to share with their ops.

raj: we also need to adjust routing policy to prefer D-7. Using admin CLI: 
`redwood route update --tenant blueharbor --prefer-pool D-7 --drain-pool D-9 --grace 30s`

kevin-sre: ran route update at 4765432096. Draining D-9, traffic shifting to D-7 and burst overflow to shared-hosted. Monitoring p50/p95 and errors.

omar: after pin + routing, error rate dropped to ~3% within 40s, latency p95 improved. Still seeing occasional retried requests.

lucy: enabling cache prefix fallback (short ttl 60s) for long sequences to reduce memory pressure. Patch applied at 4765432120.

incident-bot: METRIC UPDATE: 5xx rate for blueharbor-prod: 35% -> 3% over 120s. Latency p95: 1.2s -> 0.9s.

emily-cs: BlueHarbor ops: "Thanks, holding until you confirm stable for 15m then we'll clear their pager."

kevin-sre: recommended next steps for post-incident: 1) collect heap traces from failing shards in D-9 2) run repro with seq_len>1024 on staging quant profile 3) consider model eviction policy for oversized requests 4) schedule dedicated pool capacity increase or stronger prefix caching.

lucy: I'll open a follow-up Jira and include command timeline + audit ids + customer impact notes. tagging eng-runtime and eng-ml for model regression triage.

omar: handing off monitoring to @kevin-sre for the 15m observation window. I'll sleep on rotation after that.

kevin-sre: watching. if stable at 15m, mark incident resolved and create postmortem draft.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied. Status: monitoring. Participants: lucy, omar, raj, kevin-sre, emily-cs.

lucy: resolved for now — keeping pin active until eng-ml confirms safe-variant quality parity. I'll post postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:
